audience: school administrators and office staff at schools that keep their records in DreamClass

useCases.title: Find the school periods, classes and class courses
useCases.text: List the school periods first. Then list the classes and the class courses of one period, and use their ids in other tools.

useCases.title: Find a student and the guardians to contact
useCases.text: Search students by last name or email. Open one record, then list its guardians with their contact details.

useCases.title: Check daily attendance for a school period
useCases.text: List the students of one period and the attendance statuses. Then list the daily attendance by period, student or date range.

useCases.title: Review assignments and the gradebook of a course
useCases.text: List the assignments of one class course. Then open its gradebook to see the grade columns, weights and types.

useCases.title: Check one invoice and the fees of a period
useCases.text: List the fee definitions of a school period. Open an invoice by its id to read its status, amounts, dates, payer and fee lines.

useCases.title: Add a note to a student record
useCases.text: Find the student, then add a note with the visibility flags you need. Each flag defaults to false, so a note shows only where its flag is true.
